'''Kareena''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|human]] bartender and formerly sole owner of the [[Blaster's Path]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi's]] town of [[Raider's Cove]]. After the [[Nova Blades]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] claimed a stake in the cantina's ownership, Kareena tried to get it back to no avail. She was present when [[Gorro]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] after challenging an [[Alliance Commander|off-worlder]] to a fight, incorrectly believing them to be a pirate gang leader.

==Personality and traits==
Kareena was a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] with [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], dark skin, and black hair styled in spikes and tied back by a headband. At the time of Gorro's death in the [[Blaster's Path]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], Kareena wore a sleeveless yellow shirt with an open green vest and pale green pants.<ref name="Shadow of Revan" />

Kareena displayed a calm and assertive attitude, despite attempted threats towards her by unsavory patrons of her cantina.<ref name="Shadow of Revan" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kareena appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'', a [[2014]] expansion to the [[2011]] [[Roleplaying game|massively-multiplayer online roleplaying]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Shadow of Revan" />

Female player characters aligned with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] have the option of flirting with Kareena, asking her if she is doing anything later. Kareena states the player is "sweet for asking," but turns down the offer as she is busy managing the cantina.<ref name="Shadow of Revan" />
